name: Progress
blurb: A bar showing how far along a task is, or that it is still running.
mechanism: Native `<progress>`. Three vendor pseudo-elements do the styling because no engine exposes a single hook. Drop the value attribute (or add .is-indeterminate) and it sweeps.
caveats: The element announces a percentage; a label beside it is still worth adding for sighted users on long tasks.
Indeterminate progress tells a screen reader nothing about duration. Say what is happening in text.
support: `::-webkit-progress-value` and `::-moz-progress-bar` are vendor-specific with no shared version: each engine needs its own rule, and always has.
